vendors.name: Tellin Mak
vendors.title: Scrap Broker
vendors.description: A Reclaimer who knows the price of everything and the value of most things. Will trade you nearly anything for TC.

vendors.name: Vesryn of Varakush
vendors.title: Order Scholar
vendors.description: A Forgotten Order scholar carrying relics and runecasters for the careful researcher. Speaks in long sentences.

vendors.name: Korash of the Deep
vendors.title: True Tartarian Quartermaster
vendors.description: A subterranean quartermaster trading in heavier gear. Speaks little. Watches your hands.

vendors.name: Naha
vendors.title: Wandering Drifter
vendors.description: An unaffiliated traveller with a mixed pack. The prices are sometimes generous, sometimes not. Depends on the day.

vendors.name: Thalan
vendors.title: the Wanderer
vendors.description: Friendly and talkative, Thalan walks the roadside outposts with a horse and a limited pack. Trades common weapons and tools, sometimes coin advice.

vendors.name: Irma Ironhand
vendors.title: Heavy Armorer
vendors.description: A gruff, no-nonsense smith from the Tartarian Giant encampments. Specializes in durable armor for melee combatants.

vendors.name: Velar Shadowblade
vendors.title: Stealth Outfitter
vendors.description: Secretive and suspicious, Velar deals out of the hidden Mud Dweller market. Sells light armor and rogue gear for those who prefer to be unseen.

vendors.name: Jorah the Scholar
vendors.title: Tomekeeper
vendors.description: Kind and knowledgeable, Jorah keeps a stall at the Reclaimers' University. Focuses on wisdom-based items, scrolls, and staves.

vendors.name: Elara Lightfinger
vendors.title: Trinketmonger
vendors.description: Chatty and cunning, Elara works the urban bazaars among the Unknowing Masses. Specializes in small tools and trinkets favored by the stealthy.

vendors.name: Halem the Trader
vendors.title: General Goods
vendors.description: Friendly and trustworthy, Halem runs the village trading post — basic weapons, food, potions, perfect for restocking before the road.

vendors.name: Tarek the Tinkerer
vendors.title: Mechanical Outfitter
vendors.description: Eccentric and energetic, Tarek runs a Reclaimer workshop full of half-finished gadgets. Carries golem parts and experimental gear.

vendors.name: Felra Swiftfoot
vendors.title: Boot-Smith
vendors.description: Friendly but sneaky, Felra peddles light armor and boots from a Mud Dweller hidden camp — anything that adds a little dexterity to a step.

vendors.name: Korr Stonefoot
vendors.title: Heavy Weapons Dealer
vendors.description: Stoic and slow to trust. Carries large two-handed weapons and heavy armor pieces.

vendors.name: Cassia Nightwind
vendors.title: Ranged Weapons Specialist
vendors.description: Friendly but mysterious. Sells bows, crossbows, and projectiles, sometimes rare arrows or bolts.

vendors.name: Odar Flameforge
vendors.title: Fire-Weaponsmith
vendors.description: Proud and loud. Known for crafting fire-imbued weapons and armor with fire resistance.

vendors.name: Silvan the Quiet
vendors.title: Relic Dealer
vendors.description: Calm and quiet. Sells rare and unique magic-based items, often has relics or enchanted gear.

vendors.name: Bran the Beastmaster
vendors.title: Wilderness Outfitter
vendors.description: Enthusiastic and passionate. Animal-handling gear, potions for mounts, unique animal accessories.

vendors.name: Vela Ironheart
vendors.title: Melee Armorer
vendors.description: Stern and disciplined. High-quality swords, axes, and shields for melee fighters.

vendors.name: Mara Stoneskin
vendors.title: Earth-Gear Vendor
vendors.description: Warm but distrustful. Stone-infused weapons and armor, protection from earth-based hazards.

vendors.name: Yara the Windcaller
vendors.title: Wind-Gear Dealer
vendors.description: Soft-spoken and patient. Light armor and wind-imbued weapons that enhance movement and speed.

vendors.name: Zorin Nightblade
vendors.title: Exotic Weapons Dealer
vendors.description: Silent and mysterious. Rare and exotic weapons, including legendary and cursed items. Expensive and risky.

vendors.name: Kirin Spellweaver
vendors.title: Arcane Gear Dealer
vendors.description: Wise and thoughtful. Magical staves, armor, and wands — often enchanted for magic users.

vendors.name: Drakos the Mercenary
vendors.title: Two-Handed Weapons Dealer
vendors.description: Bold and aggressive. High-damage two-handed weapons, ideal for strength-based characters.

vendors.name: Nalren Frostgrip
vendors.title: Frost-Gear Specialist
vendors.description: Cold and distant. Frost-imbued weapons and frost-resistant armor, rare but effective in cold environments.

vendors.name: Veska of the Hollow
vendors.title: Monarch Agent
vendors.description: A Mud Monarch agent in a flat grey hood. Talks little. Buys silences and pays in tokens with no marks. Carries small useful things for travelers who don't want to be remembered.

vendors.name: Vael of the Listening Stone
vendors.title: Devout Quartermaster
vendors.description: A faith-soured pilgrim in dust-grey vestments. The carved stone they wear at their throat picks up a hum when Giants' relics pass within reach. Trades reverently, sells nothing without a small prayer first, and watches your eyes for doubt.
